categories.main_business_segments: Kexing Biopharma primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of biopharmaceutical products including recombinant protein drugs, antibody drugs, delivery systems, microecological preparations, and carrier vaccines. The company focuses on therapeutic areas such as antiviral, oncology, immunology, hematology, digestive, and degenerative diseases. It operates both domestically and internationally with a strong emphasis on innovation and commercialization.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced biopharmaceutical technologies including recombinant protein molecular design, Fc fusion protein long-acting technology, PEGylation, antibody drug design aided by AI and computer-aided drug design (CADD), and engineered exosome-based targeted drug delivery systems. Production adheres to GMP and EU CGMP standards with strict quality control and process management. The company also capitalizes development-stage R&D expenditures for late-stage clinical projects.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kexing serves hospitals and healthcare providers primarily in China and over 70 countries globally, including the EU, Brazil, Egypt, and Southeast Asia. Key customers include medical institutions covering approximately 8,000 hospitals domestically and distributors in emerging and developed markets. The company targets patients with viral infections, cancers, autoimmune diseases, anemia, and digestive disorders.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production facilities in Jinan, Shandong Province, and subsidiaries in Shenzhen and other Chinese cities. Internationally, it has subsidiaries and commercial presence in Germany, Brazil, Mexico, Singapore, Egypt, Vietnam, and other emerging markets, with products registered or marketed in over 70 countries including the EU, UK, Canada, and Latin America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kexing operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the biopharmaceutical supply chain, encompassing drug discovery, clinical development, manufacturing, and marketing. It controls the entire value chain from R&D through production to sales and distribution, including overseas commercialization and regulatory approvals.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on high-quality biopharmaceutical innovation, internationalization, and commercialization. It emphasizes AI and digital tools to accelerate drug discovery and development, focusing on large molecule drugs for oncology, immunology, and degenerative diseases. Key R&D projects include late-stage clinical trials for interferon alpha inhalation solution, PEGylated granulocyte stimulating factor, and long-acting growth hormone. The company also pursues overseas regulatory approvals and localizes operations in key international markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of proprietary and licensed biopharmaceutical drugs in domestic and international markets. The company uses a mix of direct sales and distribution channels, including e-commerce platforms domestically and direct/indirect sales overseas. Additional income sources include government subsidies, licensing fees, and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kexing is positioned as a leading domestic recombinant protein drug manufacturer with strong market shares in several therapeutic segments such as interferon alpha and erythropoietin products. It is recognized as a top player in China’s biopharmaceutical industry and has built one of the most valuable overseas commercialization platforms among Chinese biopharma companies. Competitors include other domestic biopharmaceutical firms and multinational pharmaceutical companies in the oncology and immunology fields.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Kexing reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.41 billion, an 11.75% increase year-over-year, and achieved net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 31.48 million, reversing prior losses. The company’s total assets reached over RMB 3.16 billion with steady growth. R&D investment accounted for 14.14% of revenue, reflecting a strategic emphasis on innovation despite a reduction from the prior year. Cash flow from operations improved significantly due to cost control and efficiency gains.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kexing emphasizes high-quality, innovative biopharmaceuticals with broad therapeutic coverage and advanced technology platforms. Its products offer clinical efficacy and safety comparable or superior to international competitors, supported by AI-driven drug design and robust manufacturing capabilities. The company’s unique value lies in its integrated R&D-to-commercialization model, strong domestic market presence, and extensive international commercialization network, enabling rapid market access and patient reach globally.
